integrity: Analytic proof is self-contained. The bundled standalone symbolic and numerical verifier is supporting evidence, not an all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to the specifically calibrated star-shaped polygonal piecewise-affine hybrid family, with every modal speed greater than half the common transverse decay parameter. It proves a radial-domain basin, not attraction beyond that domain or classical smoothness at switches. Earlier 2012 and 2019 full texts were not accessible and historical priority is provisional.
title: Polygon-shape conjugacy and an explicit full-interior basin for calibrated affine oscillators
